feature: Run a program by passing its file to one command
notes: `nle app.exe` and `nle run`

feature: Load the program into the host process without emulating the CPU
notes: PE image is mapped and called directly; imports are bound to Rust functions using the Windows x64 calling convention

feature: Replace the platform OS library with reimplemented functions
notes: 1700+ functions across kernel32 / ntdll / msvcrt+ucrt / user32 / gdi32 / advapi32 / ws2_32 / others (see COVERAGE.md)

feature: Convert the program into a standalone native executable (relink)
notes: `nle relink` writes an ET_EXEC ELF that the Linux kernel loads; verified on C / C++ / Rust / Go programs

feature: Keep the original load address so absolute pointers need no relocation
notes: PE image becomes PT_LOAD segments at the preferred base; metadata segments sit above it

feature: Program reads its own files beside it (data / DLLs)
notes: bundled DLLs are copied next to the output; `GetModuleFileName` points beside the ELF

feature: Report how much of a program is supported before running it
notes: `nle inspect` with per-library import counts and a verdict (native / partial / unsupported)

feature: Machine-readable report
notes: `nle inspect --json`

feature: List every API the runtime implements
notes: `nle coverage` (text / json / markdown)

feature: Check that the host can run it
notes: `nle doctor`

feature: Let the kernel run the converted file directly
notes: relinked ELF runs by itself; `nle binfmt install` also makes plain `.exe` files launchable

feature: Case-insensitive file names and `C:\` paths
notes: `C:` maps to a prefix directory and `Z:` to `/`; lookups ignore case

feature: Windows registry
notes: persistent hive saved under the prefix and shared with child processes; seeded with Windows version, code page and CPU keys; no hive files, no merged HKCR view

feature: Threads and synchronisation (events / mutexes / semaphores / SRW locks / condition variables)
notes: futex-based; wait-for-multiple with wait-all supported

feature: Thread-local storage (static TLS and TlsAlloc / FlsAlloc)
notes: per-thread TEB with ThreadLocalStoragePointer

feature: Structured exception handling and C++ exceptions (mingw / libgcc)
notes: .pdata unwinder; two-phase dispatch; hardware faults become exceptions

feature: MSVC C++ exceptions (`_CxxThrowException`)
notes: not implemented; programs that throw MSVC exceptions stop with a clear message

feature: Loading DLLs next to the program (LoadLibrary / imports)
notes: DLLMain and TLS callbacks run; forwarded exports resolved

feature: Console input and output with ANSI colour mapping
notes: console handles on a terminal; pipes and files behave like Windows

feature: Unicode: wide APIs and UTF-8 code page
notes: ACP and OEM code page report 65001

feature: Networking (Winsock blocking and non-blocking)
notes: sockets map to host sockets; WSAEWOULDBLOCK semantics; select and poll

feature: Overlapped and IOCP networking
notes: IOCP object exists for files and pipes; overlapped sockets are not implemented

feature: Create child processes
notes: CreateProcess starts Windows children through `nle` and Linux programs directly; pipes and environment pass through

feature: Process listing (Toolhelp)
notes: processes / modules / threads snapshots

feature: Memory management (VirtualAlloc / heaps / file mappings)
notes: VirtualQuery reads /proc/self/maps

feature: Wine as a fallback backend
notes: chosen automatically when the program needs APIs the native layer lacks and Wine is installed

feature: Choose the backend explicitly
notes: `--backend auto|native|wine`

feature: Isolated Windows environment (environment variables / directories)
notes: Windows-view environment is separate from the host's; `NLE_PREFIX`

feature: Clear error when a missing API is called
notes: names the API and the call site; `--strict` refuses to start

feature: Trace what the program does
notes: `NLE_TRACE=load|bind|api|all`

feature: 32-bit Windows programs
notes: out of scope: the native layer is x64 only

feature: .NET programs
notes: out of scope: needs a CLR

feature: Windows on ARM64 hosts
notes: x86-64 hosts only; native execution is the design

feature: Win32 windows, GDI drawing and basic controls
notes: X11 display (or a scripted headless one); windows, messages, GDI, BUTTON / STATIC / EDIT / LISTBOX / COMBOBOX / SCROLLBAR, MessageBox, timers, clipboard; see docs/GUI.md

feature: Sandboxing
notes: programs run with the user's rights; not a security boundary

feature: Menus, dialog resources and common controls
notes: menu bars and pop-ups, accelerators, dialogs from RT_DIALOG, resources from the executable, comctl32 (tool bar, status bar, tab, list view, tree view, progress / track / spin, image lists); no rich edit, MDI or common dialogs

feature: Direct3D / OpenGL graphics
notes: out of scope

feature: Headless display driven by a script
notes: NLE_GUI=headless with NLE_GUI_SCRIPT; used by the tests and the screenshots
